about: Fidelity bench cases, 24 September 2026. Each gold list was written by hand from the prompt's words only, independently of any model and of Kleo's own spec writer: it is what a person who read the request would check the film against. Kinds are src/spec.ts SPEC_KINDS. 'visual' = the pictures must show it (or, for kind exclude, must NOT show it); 'must' = the user said it (false = only hinted). Events carry 'order' (the user's order). 'stress' names the loss type the case is there to catch; 'source' production = a real request that went wrong in production (9-22 September). Look items carry 'who' (the gold id of the character or object they describe); 'group': true marks a crowd (no identity check); 'at': first|last pins a shot item to the film's first or last picture.

cases.stress: character look dropped (appearance facts), a line the narration must say, the old HOOK/REVEAL skeleton over a story
cases.prompt: Una dolce pasticcera magra, capelli biondi corti e raccolti, grembiule lilla, organizza una festa a sorpresa per la sua migliore amica: prepara la torta di nascosto nel suo laboratorio, decora la pasticceria con i palloncini e quando l'amica entra tutti gridano sorpresa. La narrazione deve dire "festa a sorpresa".

gold.text: a woman pastry chef is the main character
the pastry chef is thin / slim
the pastry chef has short blonde hair
the pastry chef's hair is tied up (bun or ponytail)
the pastry chef wears a lilac (light purple) apron
her best friend (a second woman) appears
she secretly prepares a cake in her kitchen/workshop
she decorates the pastry shop with balloons
the friend walks in and everyone shouts surprise
the story takes place in her pastry shop / bakery
balloons are visible
the narration says the words "festa a sorpresa"
the pastry chef comes across as sweet and gentle

cases.prompt: Uno Short in stile Star Wars: un giovane guerriero incappucciato su un pianeta desertico riceve una trasmissione, il nemico è sopravvissuto. Attraversa delle rovine antiche fino a un tempio, una voce lo chiama per nome, lui abbassa il cappuccio e accende una spada di energia blu.

gold.text: a young warrior is the main character
the warrior wears a hood (hooded robe or cloak)
a desert planet (sand, dunes, alien sky)
the warrior receives a transmission (a message, hologram or signal)
the transmission tells that the enemy has survived (said in the narration or shown)
the warrior crosses ancient ruins
the warrior reaches a temple
a voice calls the warrior by name
the warrior lowers the hood, revealing the face
the warrior ignites a blue energy sword
a glowing blue energy sword is visible
space-opera look in the spirit of Star Wars (without logos or real actors)

cases.stress: the two cars' colours swapped or lost, the climax (last curve) replaced by an invented ending
cases.prompt: A red car and a blue car race wheel to wheel on a coastal circuit at dawn, all the way to the last curve.

a racing circuit along the coast, with the sea visible
it is dawn: low early sun, dawn light
the race goes on neck and neck through the circuit
the race builds to the last curve, still wheel to wheel

cases.stress: a user-dictated narration (verbatim) rewritten by the planner
cases.prompt: Use this narration, word for word: "Every morning at six, Maria opens the bakery. The street is still dark. The first loaf is always for Mr. Rossi, who never says thank you. Today, he leaves a flower on the counter." Show the bakery on a narrow cobbled street; Maria is in her sixties and wears a white headscarf.

gold.text: the narration says "Every morning at six, Maria opens the bakery."
the narration says "The street is still dark."
the narration says "The first loaf is always for Mr. Rossi, who never says thank you."
the narration says "Today, he leaves a flower on the counter."
the narration contains nothing but those four sentences (no added lines)
Maria, a woman in her sixties
Maria wears a white headscarf
a bakery on a narrow cobbled street
the street is still dark (early morning)
Mr. Rossi, an older man, a customer
Maria gives Mr. Rossi the first loaf
Mr. Rossi leaves a flower on the counter

gold.text: the FIRST shot is a high overhead (top-down or aerial) view of a lonely lighthouse on a rock
it is night
